sql: SELECT caller_name, callee_name, file, line FROM calls WHERE callee_file LIKE '%xtask/src/pre_push.rs' AND callee_kind = 'fn' AND file NOT LIKE '%xtask/src/pre_push.rs' ORDER BY file, line

SELECT callee_name, callee_kind, COUNT(*) AS sites, COUNT(DISTINCT file) AS files FROM refs WHERE callee_file LIKE '%xtask/src/pre_push.rs' AND file NOT LIKE '%xtask/src/pre_push.rs' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY sites DESC, callee_name
